name: Shin★Ikemen Micchaku Shuzai
source:
You’ve been working for two years as a reporter for a famous women magazine QUEEN!
But one day, you are suddenly tasked with writing the sough-after "Total Coverage" section and you have to cover closely an handsome genius ?!

24 hours a day, close to each other day and night,
a love begins…?!

Every handsome genius has his little secrets.
What is hidden behind his pure face might hinder your love story…?

[from [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=jp.arismile.o17a210]Google Play[/url]]
translation:
你在著名女性杂志QUEEN担任记者已经两年了！
然而某天，你突然被指派撰写备受追捧的“全方位报道”栏目，必须对一位英俊的天才进行贴身采访？！

一天24小时，朝夕相处，
一段恋情就此开始……？！

每一位英俊的天才都有自己的小秘密。
那张纯洁面孔背后隐藏的真相，或许会阻碍你们的恋情……

[来自 [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=jp.arismile.o17a210]Google Play[/url]]
